svg.title: foundations-system
svg.desc: Vuga concept design. Editable vector paths and live text; no embedded screenshots.

g.data-name: A warm, playful communication concept with space to focus.
g.text: A warm, playful communication concept with space to focus.

g.data-name: Large symbols, consistent controls, and a voice for everyday choices.
g.text: Large symbols, consistent controls, and a voice for everyday choices.

g.data-name: Concept for school and caregiver review · October 2026
g.text: Concept for school and caregiver review · October 2026

g.data-name: Dark labels on quiet surfaces. Colour supports the symbol and its label.
g.text: Dark labels on quiet surfaces. Colour supports the symbol and its label.

g.data-name: Teal is the primary action colour. Pastels frame content; they do not encode a diagnosis or a universal AAC colour system. Retain a learner’s familiar symbols and category colours when appropriate.
g.text: Teal is the primary action colour. Pastels frame content; they do not encode a diagnosis or a universal AAC colour system. Retain a learner’s familiar symbols and category colours

g.data-name: Segoe UI · matches the current app’s Windows font.
g.text: Segoe UI · matches the current app’s Windows font.

g.data-name: Choose what you want to say.
g.text: Choose what you want to say.

g.data-name: Keep labels visible and allow wrapping. Review Kinyarwanda labels with a fluent speaker and the school. Font substitution after import can change line breaks.
g.text: Keep labels visible and allow wrapping. Review Kinyarwanda labels with a fluent speaker and
the school. Font substitution after import can change line breaks.

g.data-name: A consistent rhythm across tablet and phone.
g.text: A consistent rhythm across tablet and phone.

g.data-name: Tile grids stay in a predictable order. Suggestions have a separate area. Phone layouts use fewer columns, with large targets and scrolling.
g.text: Tile grids stay in a predictable order. Suggestions have a separate area. Phone
layouts use fewer columns, with large targets and scrolling.

g.data-name: These are layout specifications, not a claim about physical accessibility. Test size, spacing and reach on the intended device with each learner.
g.text: These are layout specifications, not a claim about physical accessibility. Test size, spacing and
reach on the intended device with each learner.

g.data-name: Examples for a reusable component library in Figma.
g.text: Examples for a reusable component library in Figma.

g.data-name: Simple illustrated objects with strong outlines, generous white space and readable labels.
Illustrations are design placeholders. Test recognition and keep existing learned symbol mappings before adopting a new set.
g.text: recognition and keep existing learned symbol
mappings before adopting a new set.

g.data-name: Keep every state understandable when animation is disabled.
g.text: Keep every state understandable when animation is disabled.

g.data-name: A small press response confirms touch. No bouncing or moving neighbouring tiles.
g.text: A small press response confirms touch. No bouncing or

g.data-name: A new chip appears softly. Existing symbols and category positions stay stable.
g.text: A new chip appears softly. Existing symbols and category

g.data-name: Honour the device preference and a caregiver override. No looping background animation.
g.text: Honour the device preference and a caregiver override.

g.data-name: What to validate at the school
g.text: What to validate at the school

g.data-name: Do these symbols and words represent what the learner wants to say, including refusal, help, feelings and social connection?
g.text: Do these symbols and words represent what the learner
wants to say, including refusal, help, feelings and social

g.data-name: Can the learner find, see and select the desired item comfortably? Does the number of visible choices suit them?
g.text: Can the learner find, see and select the desired item
comfortably? Does the number of visible choices suit them?

g.data-name: Ask about colour, illustration style and motion. Use the learner’s preferences; an attractive interface is not the same as an effective communication aid.
g.text: Ask about colour, illustration style and motion. Use the
learner’s preferences; an attractive interface is not the same

g.data-name: Design concept only. No child study or clinical benefit is claimed.
g.text: Design concept only. No child study or clinical benefit is claimed.

g.data-name: SVG imports contain vector layers; create Figma components and prototype links after import.
g.text: SVG imports contain vector layers; create Figma components and prototype links after import.
